summary: Lithuania Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian Material Change Report disclosing the September 15, 2026 close of a US$180 million strategic investment from Ganfeng Lithium Group. The investment was structured as a six-year unsecured convertible note with a 4.0% coupon and a US$12.50 conversion price. Net proceeds plus cash on hand will fully repay the company's US$259 million convertible notes due January 2027. Ganfeng currently owns roughly 9.6% of shares; full conversion adds 14.4 million shares, lifting its fully diluted stake to about 16.1%. The Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes consolidation remains on track to close by end-September 2026. Watch for the pending JV completion and conversion-driven dilution as key catalysts.
